steps.title: Lunch in Riverside Café
steps.context_uz: Kamola Londondagi kafega tushlik qilish uchun kirdi.

lines.en: Hi there! Are you ready to order?
Yes, I'd like the chicken salad, please.
Sure. Would you like anything to drink?
Can I have some sparkling water?
Of course. Is that to eat in or to take away?
lines.uz: Albatta. Shu yerda yeysizmi yoki olib ketasizmi?

lines.en: To eat in, please. Do you have any desserts?
We have some lovely apple cake today.
Perfect. And could I have the bill at the end, please?

steps.body_uz:
Ingliz tilida "I want" qo'pol eshitiladi. Buning o'rniga: **I'd like...** · **Can I have...?** · **Could I have...?** (eng xushmuomala).
**some** — tasdiq gapda va taklif/so'rovda: I'd like **some** water. Would you like **some** cake?
**any** — inkor va oddiy so'roqda: Do you have **any** desserts? We don't have **any** milk.

examples.en: Could I have a coffee, please?
Sorry, we don't have any soup today.

steps.prompt: Write a short dialogue between you and a waiter. Use I'd like, Can I have, some and any.
steps.example: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Me: Yes, I'd like a cheese sandwich, please. Waiter: Anything to drink? Me: Can I have some green tea? Do you have any cakes? Waiter: Yes, we have chocolate cake.

steps.title: Monday morning
steps.context_uz: Dushanba kuni ertalab ikki hamkasb dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashmoqda.

lines.en: Morning, Sardor! Did you have a good weekend?
lines.uz: Xayrli tong, Sardor! Dam olish kunlari yaxshi o'tdimi?

lines.en: Yes, thanks! On Saturday we went to Chimgan with some friends.
lines.uz: Ha, rahmat! Shanba kuni do'stlar bilan Chimyonga bordik.

lines.en: Wow! What did you do there?
We walked in the mountains and had a picnic. We had a great time.
lines.uz: Tog'larda sayr qildik va piknik qildik. Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.

lines.en: Sounds amazing. Did you do anything on Sunday?
lines.uz: Zo'r ekan. Yakshanba kuni biror narsa qildingizmi?

lines.en: No, I didn't. I was really tired, so I stayed at home. What about you?
lines.uz: Yo'q. Juda charchagan edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim. Sizchi?

lines.en: I saw a film at the cinema and cooked dinner for my parents.
lines.uz: Kinoteatrda film ko'rdim va ota-onamga kechki ovqat pishirdim.

steps.body_uz:
Tugagan, vaqti ma'lum o'tgan ish uchun (yesterday, last week, two days ago).
**To'g'ri fe'llar: + ed** → walk**ed**, visit**ed**, stay**ed**, cook**ed**.
**Noto'g'ri fe'llarni yodlash kerak:** go → **went**, see → **saw**, have → **had**, do → **did**, eat → **ate**, buy → **bought**.
Inkor va so'roqda **did** yordamchi fe'li, asosiy fe'l esa oddiy shaklda: I **didn't go**. **Did** you **see** it? ("Did you saw" — xato!)
be: I/he/she **was**, you/we/they **were**.

examples.en: She bought a new phone last week.
examples.uz: U o'tgan hafta yangi telefon sotib oldi.

lessons.title: Excuse me, where is...?
lessons.goal_uz: Yo'l so'raysiz va tushuntirasiz: next to, opposite, turn left, go straight on.

words.ex: Excuse me, is there a bank near here?
Turn left at the traffic lights.
Turn right after the bridge.
Go straight on for two minutes.
The café is next to the bank.
The hotel is opposite the park.
It's between the pharmacy and the school.
There's a shop on the corner.

steps.title: Looking for the station
steps.context_uz: Nodir Edinburgda temir yo'l stansiyasini qidirmoqda.

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
lines.uz: Kechirasiz, temir yo'l stansiyasiga qanday borsam bo'ladi?

lines.en: Go straight on along this street and turn left at the traffic lights.
lines.uz: Shu ko'cha bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring va svetoforda chapga buriling.

lines.en: Left at the traffic lights. OK.
Then take the second right. The station is opposite a big supermarket.
lines.uz: Keyin ikkinchi o'ngga buriling. Stansiya katta supermarketning ro'parasida.

lines.en: Is it far?
No, it's about ten minutes on foot.
Thank you so much!

steps.body_uz:
Joy: **next to** (yonida) · **opposite** (ro'parasida) · **between A and B** (A va B o'rtasida) · **on the corner** (burchakda) · **near** (yaqinida).
Yo'l ko'rsatishda **buyruq gap** ishlatiladi — fe'l bilan boshlanadi, "you" kerak emas: **Turn** left. **Go** straight on. **Take** the second right.
So'rash: **How do I get to...?** · **Is there a ... near here?**
